title: hallmap_provenance_v1
description: Provenance object for ONE frozen design Hall-map set (docs/hallmap/HALLMAP_PRODUCTION_SPEC.md). It is embedded in the map file as meta.provenance next to the meta keys that abep_sim/hall_map.py already requires (hall_map_schema_v1 meta_required). It carries no physics values and no results; it binds a map to the admitted transport member, the admission evidence, the solver pin, the chemistry configuration, Vyovrinda's own geometry and B(z), the numerics, the wall model and the validity domain. Status: specification only. No map exists and none may be generated while the credible set is empty (hallthruster_bridge/ensemble/transport_ensemble_v0.json). Every 'x-' keyword is an annotation for producers, consumers and tests; standard JSON Schema validators ignore it.
x-status: SPEC_v1 (2026-09-26); schema only, no instance exists

x-hall_map_meta_mapping.description: Every key of hall_map_schema_v1.meta_required (abep_sim/hall_map.REQUIRED_META) and the provenance path that must hold the same information. The consumer must refuse a map whose top-level meta disagrees with its provenance (x-consistency_rules).

x-consistency_rules: meta.grid, meta.dt_s, meta.duration_s, meta.average_start_s equal the provenance.numerics values
meta.ensemble_member_id == provenance.ensemble_member.ensemble_member_id, and the id passes abep_sim.hall_ensemble.require_admitted at generation AND at load
list(axes.keys()) == [a.name for a in provenance.axes] (same order: fields are flattened row-major in this axis order)
provenance.ensemble_member.admission equals the 'admission' block of that member in the ensemble file whose sha256 is provenance.ensemble_member.ensemble_file_sha256

sha256(hallthruster_bridge/<provenance.ensemble_member.admission.o4_dispositions_file>) == provenance.ensemble_member.admission.o4_dispositions_sha256, that record has schema o4_dispositions_v1, its mandatory_decision_sha256 == provenance.ensemble_member.admission.decision_sha256, and it lists provenance.ensemble_member.ensemble_member_id in cleared_for_admission (hall_ensemble._check_o4 at generation AND at load)

map_set_id.description: unique id; one id per (member x chemistry config x propellant x geometry version x B-field version x wall setting x numerics)

status.description: CANDIDATE: generated, not yet convergence-checked or not yet accepted by the owner. FROZEN: accepted; requires numerics.convergence.verdict == PASS. WITHDRAWN: member eliminated, pin moved, or inputs superseded; never loaded for the trade/UQ

case_file.description: the generated per-node case file actually run (all nodes)

ensemble_member_id.description: must be an ADMITTED member (abep_sim.hall_ensemble.require_admitted); screening candidates are refused by the generator and by HallMap

transport_parameters.description: exactly the member's transport_parameters from the ensemble file; never retuned for the design geometry

transport_as_run.description: the solver's own string of the anomalous-transport model as run (bridge 'transport' output); equals meta.transport

chemistry_variant.description: config file name, e.g. n2_n.toml; a discrete map-set label, never an interpolation axis

validity_status.description: a map set may not use any 'unresolved' table

f_out_tolerance.description: per-reaction extrapolated-activity share allowed at a chemistry_trustworthy node (hall_map_schema_v1; CLAUDE.md item 5). Not relaxed for maps

limitation.description: must state that built-in tables have no project validity manifest, so chemistry_trustworthy reduces to converged AND sustained (hall_map_schema_v1)

gas.description: e.g. N2 or Xe; a map-set label. Mixtures need their own reaction set (CLAUDE.md item 4) and a composition axis

composition_basis.description: for a composition axis: fraction definition (mole or mass) and the intake-delivered composition model it spans; 'single gas' otherwise

file.x-note: Vyovrinda's OWN design geometry; P5/ECHT evidence geometry is never a design geometry

source.description: design release (drawing / document id and revision)

file.x-note: Vyovrinda's OWN B(z) (magnetic-circuit design or measurement); P5 coil shapes 1p6kW/3p0kW are calibration nuisance and never a design field

B_ref_T.description: reference field at scale factor 1 (the B_scale axis multiplies it)

shape_fixed.description: the B(z) shape is fixed within a map set; only its amplitude may be an axis

scale_mechanism.const: B_ref_T scaling of the fixed-shape profile (bridge measured_bfield), solver magnetic_field_scale = 1

type.description: the grid type used in the P5 validation runs (bridge_lib.jl); another type is a numerics change

enum: solver default at the pinned commit

matches_admission_numerics.description: true iff grid, dt, duration, averaging window and timestepping equal those under which the member was admitted

prereg_file.description: the FROZEN convergence pre-registration; the draft in docs/hallmap/drafts/ is never valid here

wall_loss_model.description: solver string of the wall model as run, e.g. WallSheath(<material>, <loss_scale>)

facility_ingestion.description: design maps are flight (space) maps (hall_map_schema_v1 meta_required.facility_ingestion)

axes.description: ORDERED like the map's 'axes' object; fields are flattened row-major in this order

fields_present.x-must-equal: abep_sim.hall_map.REQUIRED_FIELDS (derived from hallthruster_bridge/hall_map_schema_v1.json 'fields'; tests/test_hallmap_spec.py checks the enum)

thrust.const: thrust_N as defined in hall_map_schema_v1 (1-D ion momentum flux); solver apply_thrust_divergence_correction not enabled by the bridge; no P5 beam-efficiency reading (A/B) applied

failed_node_values.const: null for every non-flag field of a node without solver output; flags false; never a number

performance_rule.const: HallMap query 'trustworthy': every surrounding grid node converged AND interpolated sustained > 0.999 AND every surrounding node chemistry_trustworthy

wall_life_rule.const: HallMap query 'wall_life_trustworthy': performance trustworthy AND meta.ion_wall_losses is true AND every surrounding node wall_life_trustworthy

axis_bounds_only.description: queries outside the axes raise (HallMap); the map is valid nowhere else

description.description: operating range, gas, thruster and field in which the member was admitted (from its admission evidence)

transfer_statement.description: explicit statement that applying the member's closure to Vyovrinda's geometry/B(z) is a transfer hypothesis (evidence level 7 for the transport form, docs/EVIDENCE.md), not a validation

evidence.description: docs/EVIDENCE.md 'Future': Hall-map provenance objects carry these attributes programmatically

uncertainty.description: at least: across-member envelope (reported separately, never merged here), chemistry-variant spread, numerical-convergence deltas

per_reaction_chemistry_retained.description: each node's bridge record keeps chemistry_per_reaction / chemistry_unresolved_rate_files, so f_out can be audited independently of 'sustained'

forbidden_axis_names.description: Layer-1 calibration nuisance (transport_ensemble_v0.json calibration_nuisance keys) and their common spellings: uncertainty in what the P5 experiment WAS; never a Vyovrinda map axis. Also facility-only variables (flight maps) and member/chemistry labels that are discrete map-set labels, not interpolation axes.

admission_record.description: copy of the member's admission block (hallthruster_bridge/ensemble/admission_record_schema_v1.json); required keys = abep_sim.hall_ensemble.ADMISSION_FIELDS on the execution baseline (claude/nifty-ramanujan-w68f9z, commit bd0b6ce 'Admission gated on O4 dispositions'), including the O4 dispositions file and its sha256 that hall_ensemble._check_o4 verifies (ensemble/o4_dispositions_schema_v1.json; owner decision 2026-09-26: admission and design Hall maps stay gated until the O4 dispositions are complete, even after a PROMOTABLE result)

passing_layer1_members.x-note: calibration nuisance recorded as PROVENANCE of the admission only; never an axis, never a map-set label

o4_dispositions_file.description: path (relative to hallthruster_bridge/) of the owner's O4 dispositions record, schema o4_dispositions_v1 (ensemble/o4_dispositions_schema_v1.json)

o4_dispositions_sha256.description: sha256 of o4_dispositions_file, verified by hall_ensemble._check_o4; the trigger values themselves are read from the scored O4 files, never from the disposition record
